create_passthrough_executor: create a PassthroughRenderExecutor to execute OpenGL rendering calls on the current thread without overhead
create_offloading_executor: create an OffloadingRenderExecutor to offload OpenGL rendering calls to a dedicated background thread
use_execution_context: use the execution_context context manager to safely call OpenGL functions through a render executor
terminate_executor: terminate a render executor and optionally run a cleanup callable before releasing resources
check_terminated_status: check the terminated property of a render executor to see if it has been shut down
